name: Hegai
title: King's Harem Overseer
summary: Hegai was the court official in charge of King Ahasuerus' harem in Susa. He played an important role in Esther's life by showing her special favor and helping her with preparations before she met the king. His goodwill contributed to Esther being chosen as queen.

keyEvents.title: Receives responsibility for the young women
keyEvents.description: Hegai was appointed to oversee all the young virgins gathered for the king's harem as candidates to become queen.

keyEvents.title: Shows favor to Esther
keyEvents.description: When Esther came under Hegai's care, she won his favor. He quickly arranged for her to receive beauty treatments, special food, and seven maidservants, and gave her the best place in the harem.

keyEvents.title: Advises Esther before meeting the king
keyEvents.description: When it was Esther's turn to go in to the king, she asked for nothing other than what Hegai recommended. This shows that she trusted his advice and guidance.
